action.description: Action when limit reached: halt or truncate

status.description: Job status when limit reached: failed, aborted, or custom

format.description: Format for webhook notifications (json, xml, form)

id.description: The ID of the password (same as path).

path.description: Path to the key within the key store.

block.description: Manages a Rundeck password in the key storage.

id.description: The ID of the private key (same as path).

key_material.description: The private key material to store, in PEM format.

path.description: Path to the key within the key store.

block.description: Manages a Rundeck private key in the key storage.

description.description: Description of the project to be shown in the Rundeck UI.

extra_config.description: Additional raw configuration parameters to include in the project configuration. Keys should use dot notation (e.g., "foo.bar") as required by the Rundeck API.

id.description: The ID of the project (same as name).

ssh_key_file_path.description: Path to SSH key file on filesystem.

ssh_key_storage_path.description: Path to SSH key in Rundeck key storage.

ui_url.description: URL of the project in the Rundeck UI.

config.description: Configuration parameters for the resource model source.

type.description: The resource model source plugin type.

download_token.description: Download token for the runner package.

installation_type.description: Installation type of the runner (linux, windows, kubernetes, docker).

project_name.description: Name of the project where the runner will be created.

remote_node_dispatch.description: Enable remote node dispatch for the runner.

replica_type.description: Replica type of the runner (manual or ephemeral).

runner_as_node_enabled.description: Enable the runner to act as a node.

runner_node_filter.description: Node filter string for the runner.

tag_names.description: Comma separated tags for the runner. Rundeck normalizes tags to lowercase and sorts them alphabetically. The provider handles this automatically to prevent plan drift.

delete.description: True if the key should be deleted when the resource is deleted. Defaults to true if key_material is provided in the configuration.

id.description: The ID of the public key (same as path).

key_material.description: The public key data to store, in the usual OpenSSH public key file format.

path.description: Path to the key within the key store.

url.description: URL at which the key content can be retrieved.

block.description: Manages a Rundeck public key in the key storage.

access_level.description: Access level for the project. Valid values: 'read', 'execute', 'admin'.

runner_as_node_enabled.description: Enable the runner to act as a node for this project.

runner_node_filter.description: Node filter string for the runner in this project.

assigned_projects_config.description: Map of project configurations with full dispatch settings. When a project appears in both assigned_projects and assigned_projects_config, assigned_projects_config takes precedence.

installation_type.description: Installation type of the runner (linux, windows, kubernetes, docker).

project_runner_as_node.description: Map of projects where runner acts as node.

auth_token.description: The authentication token for the webhook. Only available after creation.

enabled.description: Whether the webhook is enabled. Cannot be changed after creation - requires replacement.

event_plugin.description: The plugin type (e.g., 'webhook-run-job', 'log-webhook-event'). Cannot be changed after creation.

id.description: The unique identifier of the webhook.

name.description: The name of the webhook. Cannot be changed after creation - requires replacement.

project.description: The project name that owns the webhook.

roles.description: Comma-separated list of roles for authorization. Cannot be changed after creation - requires replacement.

user.description: The username the webhook executes as. Cannot be changed after creation.

arg_string.description: Job option arguments for webhook-run-job plugin, in the form '-opt1 value -opt2 "other value"'

as_user.description: Execute job as specified user for webhook-run-job plugin

auto_subscribe.description: Automatically confirm SNS subscription (aws-sns-webhook plugin only)

batch_key.description: JSONPath to key containing items to treat as individual events (advanced-run-job, datadog-run-job, pagerduty-run-job)

event_id_key.description: JSONPath to key containing value to use as the event ID; works with batches (advanced-run-job, datadog-run-job, pagerduty-run-job, pagerduty-V3-run-job)

key_storage_path.description: Key storage path for advanced-run-job and Enterprise plugins

log_level.description: Log level for log-webhook-event plugin (INFO, DEBUG, WARN, ERROR)

node_filter.description: Node filter override for webhook-run-job plugin

return_processing_info.description: Return processing information to the caller of the webhook. Default return is {"msg":"ok"} (advanced-run-job and Enterprise plugins)

secret.description: GitHub webhook secret for authentication (github-webhook plugin only)

block.description: Plugin-specific configuration. Structure varies by event_plugin type.

job_id.description: UUID of the job to run

job_name.description: Name of the job (computed from job_id)

node_filter.description: Node filter override for job execution

condition.description: Condition operator: equals, contains, dateTimeAfter, dateTimeBefore, exists, isA

path.description: JSONPath to the event field to evaluate

block.description: Conditions that must be met for this rule to trigger
